title: psychotria costivenia subsp. altorum
intro: Psychotria costivenia subsp. altorum, commonly known as the "Madre de Cacao" or "Mother of Cocoa," is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Psychotria costivenia subsp. altorum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antiseptic and antipyretic properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties of Psychotria costivenia subsp. altorum, but its traditional uses suggest a promising potential for the treatment of various diseases.
